title: 第五章 苦肉阴谋步步入瓮第六章 星阵锁天绝境困战神
lines: 万里沧波浩渺，海面风平浪静、碧波万顷，万里长空一碧如洗，无半分风浪。
三日平稳航程，龙国帝驾龙舟乘风破浪、昼夜兼程，顺利跨越万里海域，稳稳踏入黑日国北海疆域境内。
入目所见，一派祥和盛景，完美复刻出国泰民安、盛世太平的模样，挑不出半分破绽。
北海海岸红毯铺地、绵延十里，礼乐长鸣、钟鼓齐奏，典雅祥和的乐曲萦绕海天。
黑日国文武百官全员列队、整齐伫立，人人躬身俯首、姿态恭敬，神色谦卑诚恳，无半分敌对肃穆、杀伐紧绷之意。
黑日皇亲自立于城楼之下、海岸最前，一身简约常服、毫无帝王威仪压迫，亲自等候迎接，礼数周全、态度谦逊，完美演绎出诚心求和、俯首认错、敬畏龙国的卑微姿态。
整场迎接仪式盛大隆重、规矩森严、祥和安稳，场面恢弘却无半分军备肃杀之气，处处彰显着和平友善的氛围。
一路行来，海岸繁华、市井热闹，商铺林立、人流往来，百姓安居乐业、神色平和，丝毫没有大战将至、杀机暗藏的紧绷姿态。
这般面面俱到、毫无破绽的假象，饶是心存最后一丝警惕的四大战神，此刻也不由稍稍放松了心神。
对方举国相迎、君主亲迎、百官俯首、礼数周全，举国上下一片平和，这般场面，任谁也无法相信，这里是一处暗藏绝杀、埋葬无敌战神的死地。
众人跟随黑日皇入城，穿过繁华市井、恢弘长街，一路谈笑平和、氛围融洽，和谈的顺利程度，远超所有人的预料。
可这份精心营造的祥和与安稳，仅仅维持了半个时辰，便被一场突如其来的叛乱，彻底撕碎。
轰隆——！
皇城腹地深处骤然炸响一声惊天巨响，火光冲天、硝烟弥漫，剧烈的爆炸冲击波席卷四方，震得整座皇城微微震颤。
无数黑衣死士手持锋利忍刃、煞气滔天，从皇城暗处、街巷阴影、宫殿夹层之中骤然杀出，直奔皇宫大殿方向，杀伐震天、气势汹汹。
“叛贼作乱！”
“四大天忍谋反，刺杀陛下！速速护驾！”
凄厉急促的嘶吼声响彻整座皇城，瞬间撕裂所有祥和氛围，打破来之不易的和平假象。
四道速度极致的黑影破空而出，身法诡谲、飘忽不定、煞气凛冽，正是黑日国最顶级的暗杀战力——四大天忍。
四人皆是一身漆黑夜行衣、面罩遮面、气息阴冷，手持上古绝杀忍器，招式狠辣凌厉、招招致命，直奔黑日皇所在方向冲杀而来，完美演足了弑君谋反、以下犯上的叛贼姿态。
黑日皇故作惊慌失措、脸色惨白，厉声怒吼：“逆贼竟敢犯上作乱、弑君谋逆！皇城守军，即刻护驾！”
四周皇城守军配合默契，佯装溃败慌乱、节节败退，看似拼死阻拦，实则刻意放水、连连后撤，根本不敢阻拦四大天忍的狂暴攻势，任由四人肆意冲杀、破坏皇城防线、逼近核心区域。
一场精心编排、细节拉满、毫无破绽的惊天苦肉计，就此完美上演。
君臣反目、朝堂内乱、叛贼弑主、举国动荡、守军溃败，层层假象、步步示弱，一环扣一环，彻底瓦解了四大战神心中最后一丝警惕与防备。
在四大战神坦荡正直的武道认知里，眼前的叛乱是真实的国乱，对方的慌乱是真实的危机，一国君主身陷险境，绝非刻意伪装的陷阱。
“黑日陛下危在旦夕！”
吕布见状，眸生怒意、战意勃发，当即踏空而出、凌空而立，一身霸体之力轰然翻涌、震荡四方。
“我等身为宾客，受他国礼遇、赴约和谈，如今他国生乱、君主遇险，我等当出手平乱、稳固大局，保和谈顺利！”
其余三大战神纷纷颔首认同，秉持武道正义、心怀安稳两国的念头，不再迟疑，齐齐踏空出手，追击四大叛忍，意图快速平定叛乱、稳住局势。
四大天忍见状，眼底瞬间闪过一抹隐晦至极的阴笑，转瞬即逝、不露破绽。
四人不与四神正面硬拼、不做无谓缠斗，佯装溃败不敌、仓皇逃窜，边打边退、步步引诱，一路向着北海蛮荒无人腹地飞速逃窜。
四大战神一心平乱、心怀坦荡、毫无城府，未曾多想、未曾设防，顺势追击、步步深入。
一路追奔百里之遥，彻底远离皇城人烟市井、脱离守军庇护范围，踏入一片群山环绕、海域隔绝、与世隔绝的蛮荒死地。
此地天地灵气稀薄至极、近乎枯竭，四周群山死寂、草木荒芜、鸟兽绝迹、死气沉沉，无任何生灵踪迹，是黑日国刻意圈出的无人禁区，也是周天星曜大阵的核心阵眼所在地。
待龙行步与四大战神彻底踏入腹地深处、踏入绝杀阵心的瞬间——
唰！
四道疾驰遁光骤然停驻，四大天忍身形定格、转身而立，瞬间褪去所有慌乱溃败、仓皇逃窜的伪装。
四人同时摘下面罩，眼神冰冷刺骨、杀意滔天、煞气纵横，周身隐匿的暗黑忍力彻底爆发，死寂的天地瞬间被无尽杀机笼罩。
整片天地，瞬间死寂无声，风声骤停、云气静止，唯有漫天杀机，铺天盖地。
content_en:
Thousands of miles of vast waves, the sea surface is calm and clear, and the vast expanse of blue waves. The sky of thousands of miles is as clear as a wash, without any wind or waves.
After three days of smooth sailing, the Emperor of the Dragon Kingdom rode the wind and waves in a dragon boat, traveled day and night, successfully crossed thousands of miles of sea, and firmly entered the territory of the North Sea of ​​the Black Sun Kingdom.
What you see is a peaceful and grand scene, which perfectly reproduces the appearance of a peaceful country and a prosperous age, without any flaws.
The red carpet on the Beihai coast stretches for ten miles, with ritual music, bells and drums playing in unison, and elegant and peaceful music lingering in the sea and sky.
All the civil and military officials of the Black Sun Kingdom lined up and stood neatly. Everyone bowed their heads with respectful gestures, and their expressions were humble and sincere. There was no hint of hostility, solemnity, or tenseness in killing.
The Black Sun Emperor personally stood under the city tower and at the front of the coast. He was dressed in simple ordinary clothes and was not oppressed by the imperial majesty. He was waiting to welcome him in person. He was full of etiquette and humble in attitude, perfectly interpreting the humble posture of sincerely seeking peace, bowing his head and admitting his mistakes, and being in awe of the Dragon Kingdom.
The entire welcome ceremony was grand, solemn, strict in rules, peaceful and stable. The scene was magnificent but not a bit acrimonious, and the atmosphere of peace and friendship was everywhere.
Along the way, the coast is prosperous, the markets are lively, there are many shops, and people are coming and going. The people live and work in peace and contentment, with peaceful expressions, and there is no tense posture that indicates that a war is coming or that murderous intent is hidden.
With such a comprehensive and flawless illusion, even the four war gods who had the last bit of vigilance in their hearts could not help but relax a little at this moment.
The whole country welcomes the opponent, the monarch personally welcomes him, all the officials bow their heads, all etiquette is complete, and the whole country is peaceful. No one can believe such a scene. This is a place where the ultimate assassination is hidden and the invincible god of war is buried.
Everyone followed the Black Sun Emperor into the city and walked through the bustling market and grand long streets. They talked and laughed peacefully and the atmosphere was harmonious. The peace talks went smoothly beyond everyone's expectations.
But this carefully created peace and stability only lasted for half an hour before it was completely torn apart by a sudden rebellion.
Boom——!
There was a sudden loud explosion deep in the hinterland of the imperial city. Flames shot into the sky, smoke filled the air, and violent explosion shock waves swept across all directions, causing the entire imperial city to tremble slightly.
Countless dead men in black, armed with sharp ninja blades and full of evil aura, suddenly burst out from the darkness of the imperial city, the shadows of the streets, and the mezzanines of the palace, and went straight to the direction of the palace hall, killing with overwhelming momentum.
"The rebels are making trouble!"
"The four great celestial beings are plotting to rebel and assassinate His Majesty! Protect him quickly!"
The shrill and rapid roar resounded throughout the imperial city, instantly tearing apart all the peaceful atmosphere and breaking the illusion of hard-won peace.
Four black shadows with extremely high speeds shot out of the sky. Their movements were treacherous, erratic, and fierce. They were the top assassination forces of the Black Sun Kingdom - the Four Heavenly Ninjas.
All four of them were dressed in pitch-black night clothes, with masks covering their faces, and had cold auras. They were holding ancient ninja weapons, and their moves were fierce and deadly. They rushed straight to the direction of the Black Sun Emperor, perfectly portraying the traitorous attitude of regicide and rebellion.
The Black Sun Emperor pretended to be panicked, his face turned pale, and he shouted angrily: "How dare the traitor commit rebellion and commit regicide! The Imperial City defenders will protect him immediately!"
The surrounding imperial city defenders cooperated with each other tacitly, pretending to be defeated and retreating in panic. They seemed to be desperately trying to stop them, but in fact they deliberately released water and retreated continuously. They did not dare to stop the violent offensive of the four great ninjas, allowing the four to rush in and destroy the imperial city's defense line and approach the core area.
A carefully choreographed, detailed, flawless and shocking plot was staged perfectly.
The monarch and his ministers turned against each other, civil strife in the court, rebels and regicides, the whole country was in turmoil, and the defenders were defeated. Layers of illusions and signs of weakness, one after another, completely destroyed the last vigilance and defense in the hearts of the four war gods.
In the magnanimous and upright martial arts knowledge of the four war gods, the rebellion in front of them is a real national chaos, and the other party's panic is a real crisis. The monarch of a country is in danger, and it is by no means a deliberately disguised trap.
"His Majesty Black Sun is in danger!"
When Lu Bu saw this, his eyes were filled with anger and fighting spirit. He immediately stepped out of the air and stood in the air. The power of his body surged and shook all directions.
"As guests, we receive courtesy from other countries and attend peace talks. Now that there is chaos in other countries and the monarch is in danger, we should take action to quell the chaos, stabilize the overall situation, and ensure that the peace talks go smoothly!"
The other three war gods all nodded in agreement. Upholding the justice of martial arts and the idea of stabilizing the two countries, they no longer hesitated and took action in unison to pursue the four rebel ninja, with the intention of quickly quelling the rebellion and stabilizing the situation.
When the four great ninjas saw this, a dark and sinister smile flashed across their eyes. It was fleeting and did not reveal any flaws.
The four of them did not confront the four gods head-on or engage in meaningless fights. Instead, they pretended to be defeated and fled in a hurry. They fought and retreated, seduced step by step, and fled quickly towards the wild and uninhabited hinterland of Beihai.
The four war gods were determined to calm the chaos, were magnanimous, and had no plans. They did not think too much or set up defenses. They followed the trend and pursued deeper and deeper.
Chase all the way for hundreds of miles, completely away from the populated streets of the imperial city, out of the protection of the defenders, and into a barbaric death land surrounded by mountains, isolated by the sea, and isolated from the world.
The spiritual energy of the heaven and earth here is extremely thin and almost exhausted. The surrounding mountains are dead, the vegetation is barren, the birds and animals are extinct, lifeless, and there is no trace of any living beings. It is an uninhabited forbidden area deliberately circled by the Black Sun Kingdom, and it is also the core of the Zhoutian Xingyao Formation.
The moment when Long Xingbu and the four war gods had completely entered the depths of the hinterland and entered the heart of the decisive killing formation——
Uh-huh!
The four speeding escaping lights suddenly stopped, and the four heavenly ninjas froze, turned and stood, instantly losing all pretense of panic, defeat, and hasty flight.
The four people took off their masks at the same time, their eyes were piercingly cold, their murderous intent was monstrous, and their evil aura was rampant. The dark endurance hidden around them completely exploded, and the dead world was instantly shrouded in endless murderous intent.
The entire world fell silent for an instant, the wind stopped suddenly, the clouds were still, and only murderous intent filled the sky and covered the earth.
